title: Project site - norm-control results saved to internal safe answer folder
changes: Norm-controller result uploads no longer use the technical-customer folder /Для Технического заказчика/.../нормаконтроль.
Result files are now written under the internal norm-control exchange root: /Внутренняя технологии/Нормаконтролер/<здание>/<раздел>/ответ/.

When the section already has norm-control source files published under /Внутренняя технологии/Нормаконтролер/<здание>/<раздел>/файлы/, the site derives the answer folder from that exact source folder and replaces only 'файлы' with 'ответ'.
Fallback path construction uses the selected section building name and section code if no published source path is available.
No SQL migration required. GIP API remains required for chunk upload and archive download routes.
